answer: Re-attestations are stored in zenith and raven lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 9 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the thread graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1033 impostors cost 478 times the honest price and take 15 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
